lines.text: POV: your boss just offered you 1,500 dollars of free money.

parts.tts: pov: your boss just offered you one thousand five hundred dollars of free money.

lines.text: It's a match: save some of your pay, and they add more.

lines.text: Say you earn 50,000. They match half, up to six percent.

lines.text: You put in 3,000 a year. Spender, at the next desk, skips it.

lines.text: 1,500 extra, from your employer. Fifty cents on every dollar you saved.

lines.text: Plans differ, and some make you wait to keep it. Skip it, and that 1,500 just isn't yours.
